pageInfo.siteTitle: BaerimTools – calculators, maps and databases for Metin2 Baerim

home.title: BaerimTools
home.description: Free tools made by a player for players of the Metin2 Baerim server: crafting and upgrade cost calculators, material database, build calculator, interactive maps and game system overviews.
home.body: BaerimTools collects practical tools for Baerim players in one place. Start with Materials to look up recipes and prices, open Systems for bonuses, alchemy, exploration, metin stones, the color system and interactive maps, or plan your character in the Build Calculator.

materials.title: Materials and prices
materials.description: Browse Metin2 Baerim materials, see how craftable ones are made and which items use them, and enter your own prices to calculate crafting costs.
materials.body: This list contains the materials used for crafting and upgrading on Baerim. Open a material to see its recipe (if it can be crafted) and which items use it. Enter your own prices, or use the shared global prices, so that every cost calculation on the site reflects what things are worth on the server. Your own prices stay in your browser unless you choose to submit them.

systems.title: Game systems
systems.description: Overview of Metin2 Baerim systems: bonuses, alchemy, exploration levels, interactive Mokoko map, metin stone calculator and the color system.
systems.body: Each tile opens a separate tool: Bonuses lists items that grant a given bonus, Alchemy calculates the cost of combining alchemy stones, Exploration shows exploration levels on a map, the Mokoko Interactive Map marks collectible spots, the Metin Calculator estimates what a metin stone drops, and the Color System previews colors on characters.

bonuses.title: Bonuses
bonuses.description: Metin2 Baerim bonuses with the items that grant them and the maximum value you can reach.
bonuses.body: Choose a bonus to see the items that grant it and the maximum bonus you can reach. Switch between grid and checklist view to keep track of the items you already have.

alchemy.title: Alchemy calculator
alchemy.description: Calculate what Metin2 Baerim alchemy costs: enter the price of Cor Draconis and stones and compare the 100% and average (50%) success modes.
alchemy.body: Enter the price of Cor Draconis and of the alchemy stones to see how much it costs to reach a target stone grade. In the 100% mode two stones always combine into one of the next grade; in the average mode each attempt has a 50% chance and consumes both stones, so the calculator shows the expected cost.

exploration.title: Exploration levels
exploration.description: Map of Metin2 Baerim exploration levels with a description and screenshots for each level.
exploration.body: The map shows every exploration level. Click a marker to read what to do, where to go and how to do it, together with screenshots.

interactiveMap.title: Mokoko interactive map
interactiveMap.description: Interactive maps of Metin2 Baerim with mokoko markers and player notes. Mark collected spots and hide them, and pop the map out into its own window.
interactiveMap.body: Pick a map and click markers to view notes from other players. You can mark mokoko as collected, hide collected ones, and pop the map out into a separate window (Picture-in-Picture) to keep it visible while you play. Progress is saved in your browser.

metinCalculator.title: Metin calculator
metinCalculator.description: Metin2 Baerim metin stone calculator: see what each metin drops and estimate the value of a run with your own material prices.
metinCalculator.body: Choose a metin stone to see its drops. Toggle the drop buffs (vote, casual, glove, guild) and the calculator estimates the yang value of the drops using your own or global material prices.

colorSystem.title: Color system
colorSystem.description: Preview Metin2 Baerim weapon, armor, costume, hairstyle and sash colors on a 3D character, for both genders and every class.
colorSystem.body: Pick a gender and class, then choose a weapon, armor, costume, hairstyle or sash to preview it and try colors on a 3D model before you spend anything in the game.

oreFinder.title: Ore finder
oreFinder.description: Community map of active ore spots on Metin2 Baerim with a countdown until each ore disappears.
oreFinder.body: Players report where an ore has appeared, and the map shows active ores together with the time left until they disappear. Reporting is only possible during the xx:58–xx:09 and xx:28–xx:39 windows. You can pop the map out into its own window.

mokokoFinder.title: Mokoko finder
mokokoFinder.description: Community reports of mokoko locations on Metin2 Baerim maps, confirmed with a screenshot and approved by an admin.
mokokoFinder.body: Click the map to report a mokoko together with a screenshot as proof. Reports are reviewed by an admin, and duplicate reports of the same mokoko are merged into one.

buildCalculator.title: Build calculator
buildCalculator.description: Plan your Metin2 Baerim build: add items and see the grand total of materials and yang needed to craft and upgrade all of them.
buildCalculator.body: Search for items and add them to your build. The calculator sums the materials and yang required for crafting and upgrading everything. Set the level you already own to hide costs you have paid, and adjust pity for every item at once.

about.title: About BaerimTools
about.who: Hi! I'm a player of the Baerim Metin2 server. BaerimTools is a hobby project that I build in my free time, because I wanted to make everyday things in the game simpler for myself and for other players.
about.whatIntro: BaerimTools is a set of practical tools for Baerim players:
items: Material and item database with crafting and upgrade recipes, so you can see what you need and where it comes from.
Crafting and upgrade cost calculators that add up the required materials and yang for you.
Build calculator for planning your character.
Interactive maps with markers, notes and helpers, including finders for ores and mokoko.
Overviews of game systems such as bonuses, alchemy, exploration levels, metin stones and the color system.
about.data: The data on this site is collected and maintained manually by me with help from other players. The game changes over time, so some entries may be outdated or incomplete. If you notice a mistake, please let me know and I will fix it.
about.ads: The site is free to use. If you accept the consent banner, ads (Google AdSense) are shown to help cover hosting costs. Details are in the Privacy Policy.
about.contact: Found a bug, have an idea or want to help with data? Write to me at

adsConsent.message: This site uses local browser storage to remember your language, settings and progress. If you accept, we'll also show ads (Google AdSense) to help cover hosting costs.

intro.title: What this site is
intro.body: BaerimTools is an unofficial, fan-made tool created for players of the Baerim server (Metin2). The site is not affiliated with the Baerim team or the creators of Metin2. You don't need an account or to log in to use it.

localData.title: Data stored locally in your browser
localData.intro: The site saves some data purely locally, in your browser's storage (localStorage) — this data is never sent to any server and disappears if you clear your browsing data. It's used to remember your settings and progress between visits:
items: your chosen site language and night mode
the Metin2 nickname you entered (used to credit you in the Hall of Fame)
your list of collected mokoko on the interactive maps
comments you've liked under mokoko markers
your own manually entered material prices and your Build Calculator list
short-lived cooldowns after using a banned word in a comment

serverData.title: Data sent to the server
serverData.body: If you add a comment under a mokoko on the map (optionally with a photo), submit a price to the global price list, or leave your nickname for the Hall of Fame — that data is stored in the site's database (Cloudflare D1) and is publicly visible to other visitors. Please don't include personal information in comments — it's never needed.

hostingLogs.title: Hosting logs
hostingLogs.body: Like most websites, the hosting infrastructure (Cloudflare Pages and Workers) and database (Cloudflare D1) behind this site may routinely log IP addresses and basic technical request information (e.g. browser type) as part of normal service operation and security. We don't have direct access to this data beyond basic statistics.

ads.title: Ads
ads.body: If you accept the ads banner, this site loads Google AdSense to show ads and help cover hosting costs. AdSense may set cookies and use device information to measure and, where permitted, personalize ads. You can review and manage this at Google's Ad Settings (adssettings.google.com), and can change your mind at any time by clearing your browsing data for this site.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can delete locally stored data at any time by clearing your browsing data for this site. If you'd like us to remove a comment, photo, or Hall of Fame entry you submitted, write to us at the address below.

changes.body: This policy may be updated as the site evolves. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

communityGuide.title: Baerim Compendium
communityGuide.subtitle: Community-collected questions and answers, organized in one place for quick browsing.
communityGuide.disclaimerBody: the answers below were generated by AI based on Discord chat transcripts. They may contain inaccuracies or outdated information — when in doubt, verify directly on the server.
communityGuide.footerNote: Unofficial material · compiled from Baerim community discussions

items.q: How does the One Account Scroll work?
items.a: It applies to the account it was activated on, covering every character on that account. It does not carry over to a second account. It can be turned off, but doing so loses the scroll.

items.q: Can I activate the One Account Scroll on two accounts and farm metins on both?
items.a: No. The chat answer was unambiguous: you can't get around the limit this way.

items.q: With the One Account Scroll active, can I still fish or mine ore on a second account?
items.a: Yes, a second account can still be used for fishing and mining.

items.q: How does the Casual Buff and the metin limit work?
items.a: It boosts drops from metins, but a daily limit of around 1500 metins applies, counted across the board. The chat also mentioned a link to dungeon bonuses.

items.q: Does the double-drop event affect shrines?
items.a: According to chat answers, it no longer doubles shrines themselves; the remaining loot may still be covered by the bonus.

items.q: Where's the best place to farm the Moonlight Chest event — dungeons or metins?
items.a: On metins.

items.q: Does the 10% double-drop bonus/buff from metins apply to the Moonlight Chest?
items.a: Answers in chat were contradictory here — one person said "no," another said "it should work" — so there's no clear answer.

items.q: Which level should you stop EXP at — 54 or 55?
items.a: Level 55 was most often recommended, as long as the character already has enough damage and survivability for the Demon Tower.

items.q: Is it worth farming metins at higher levels, e.g. 70/75/80/90?
items.a: In the conversations analyzed, staying at 55 was often recommended, since higher-level metins were seen as not worth the effort.

items.q: How do you earn yang outside of dungeons and metins?
items.a: The most common answers were mining, farming the Temple, and buying cheap items to resell at a higher price. For mining, a P skill and a +5 or higher pickaxe were recommended.

items.q: Where's the best place to mine ore?
items.a: Map1 / City 1. One answer also noted that ore nodes respawn roughly every 30 minutes.

items.q: Which bonuses should you pick for a sash for PvE / Dragon?
items.a: 5% PvE versus elemental resistance came up often. One player recommended 5% PvE and covering resistance with elemental boots instead.

items.q: Is it more worth it to craft a sash yourself or buy a finished one?
items.a: Early in the game, collecting cloth and buying a finished sash was more often recommended, or crafting one later, e.g. around level 75.

items.q: How do you add bonuses to costumes?
items.a: The right items are sold by the merchant NPC. According to chat, it takes roughly 150–200 attempts on average to land 3 bonuses.

items.q: Can bonuses be rerolled on items evolved from level 54 to 81?
items.a: Yes, with regular reroll scrolls.

items.q: What's the best way to upgrade Soul EQ from +1 to +6?
items.a: Chat recommended: Dragon Scroll for +1–+3, a 100% scroll for +4, then a Magic Stone after that.

items.q: How much does rerolling bonuses in alchemy cost?
items.a: Per the answers: 1 Flame, no yang cost; the resulting bonus is random. Rerolling bonuses below Brilliant grade was discouraged.

items.q: Is it better to do mythic or legendary alchemy first?
items.a: The most common short answer: mythic.

items.q: What resistances do you need for Dragon? Why am I getting one-shot?
items.a: Magic resistance plus the matching element resistance were most often pointed to; magic resistance mainly on the helmet and bracelet, plus the right bonuses on the shield.

items.q: How do you fix lag/FPS drops when running two clients?
items.a: The most common advice: close the game and delete metin2.cfg. Capping FPS at 60 was also sometimes recommended.

items.q: Why does the game crash / reset settings / not go fullscreen?
items.a: Delete metin2.cfg, check config.exe, check your antivirus, reinstall the client, and if the problem persists — open a support ticket.

items.q: How do I buy DC / pay with Paysafecard?
items.a: This came up very often in the Polish chat. Payment goes through an external site; the field on the Baerim site was meant for gift card codes, not for entering a PSC code directly.

items.q: How does Skill Synergy work, and what needs to be maxed (P)?
items.a: For the full bonus, chat says you need all 6 main skills at P plus your buff skills at P; mining/fishing were not required for it.

items.q: What are the best first pet skills for PvM?
items.a: For a warrior, suggestions included Boss Guard → Magic/Melee Attack → Crit Power → Monster Hunter, depending on the character's needs.
